youtube_full.title: The Lions Lay Down Quiet | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Daniel 6:22
youtube_full.description:
The Lions Lay Down Quiet: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Daniel 6:22.

Some men tricked King Darius into making a new rule. For thirty days, no one could pray to anyone but the king.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Beau the Brave.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: The Lions Lay Down Quiet
1:15 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Beau the Brave
1:51 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
3:03 Question time
3:20 Sweet dreams
3:38 More stories, the app and the paperback
